name: rung4_feasibility
claim: Rung-4 feasibility on the embargoed sarcoma organoid cohort. 94 organoids are drug-screened and 17 carry an expression profile; all 17 also have screen rows, so rung-4 n = 17, with a median of 17 of the 34 drugs screened per organoid rather than a full grid. No table in data/raw/soragni/tables carries a dose or replicate column -- every (organoid, drug) pair appears exactly once -- so rung 4 has NO ceiling of its own and can only be read against rung 3. Organoid drug coverage: L1000 25/34, GDSC2 21/34, both 19, either 27.
